rules.headline: Abacavir not recommended in HLA-B*57:01-positive patients
rules.rationale: CPIC recommends against abacavir in HLA-B*57:01-positive patients because of the risk of a hypersensitivity reaction.
rules.mechanism: Immune-mediated hypersensitivity reaction associated with HLA-B*57:01.

alternatives.text: No specific alternative is encoded; see the cited guideline.

rules.headline: Allopurinol not recommended in HLA-B*58:01-positive patients
rules.rationale: CPIC recommends against allopurinol in HLA-B*58:01-positive patients because of the risk of severe cutaneous adverse reactions.
rules.mechanism: HLA-B*58:01 is associated with severe cutaneous adverse reactions (SJS/TEN, DRESS).

alternatives.text: No specific alternative is encoded; see the cited guideline.

rules.headline: Avoid carbamazepine in carbamazepine-naive HLA-B*15:02-positive patients
rules.rationale: CPIC recommends avoiding carbamazepine in HLA-B*15:02-positive patients who are carbamazepine-naive, because of the risk of SJS/TEN.
rules.mechanism: HLA-B*15:02 is associated with SJS/TEN with carbamazepine.
limitations: The recommendation addresses carbamazepine-naive patients; prior tolerance needs clinician review.
HLA-A*31:01 is not modelled in this release.

alternatives.text: No specific alternative is encoded; see the cited guideline.

rules.headline: Avoid oxcarbazepine in oxcarbazepine-naive HLA-B*15:02-positive patients
rules.rationale: CPIC 2017 recommends avoiding oxcarbazepine in HLA-B*15:02-positive patients who are naive to it. (The prototype's earlier 'dose adjustment' label was incorrect.)
rules.mechanism: HLA-B*15:02 is associated with SJS/TEN with oxcarbazepine; risk is considered lower than with carbamazepine.
limitations: Strength of recommendation not recorded in this release.
The recommendation addresses naive patients; prior tolerance needs clinician review.

alternatives.text: No specific alternative is encoded; see the cited guideline.

rules.headline: Avoid codeine in CYP2D6 ultrarapid metabolizers
rules.rationale: CPIC recommends avoiding codeine in ultrarapid metabolizers because of the potential for life-threatening toxicity from higher morphine exposure.
rules.mechanism: CYP2D6 converts codeine to morphine; ultrarapid metabolism raises morphine formation.

alternatives.text: No specific alternative is encoded; see the cited guideline.

rules.headline: Avoid codeine in CYP2D6 poor metabolizers
rules.rationale: CPIC recommends avoiding codeine in poor metabolizers because of insufficient pain relief.
rules.mechanism: Poor CYP2D6 activity reduces conversion of codeine to morphine.

alternatives.text: No specific alternative is encoded; see the cited guideline.

rules.headline: Avoid standard-dose clopidogrel if possible in CYP2C19 intermediate/poor metabolizers (ACS/PCI)
rules.rationale: For acute coronary syndrome or PCI, CPIC 2022 advises avoiding standard-dose clopidogrel in CYP2C19 intermediate and poor metabolizers where possible and using an alternative antiplatelet strategy.
rules.mechanism: Clopidogrel is a prodrug activated by CYP2C19; reduced activity lowers active-metabolite formation.
limitations: CPIC recommendations differ by indication; only ACS/PCI is encoded as a definite rule.
Alternative agents and conditions are not encoded; see the guideline.

alternatives.text: No specific alternative is encoded; see the cited guideline.

rules.headline: TPMT poor metabolizer: alternative agent or major dose reduction
rules.rationale: CPIC advises, for TPMT poor metabolizers, a considered alternative or markedly reduced thiopurine dosing depending on the clinical context.
rules.mechanism: TPMT deficiency leads to accumulation of active thiopurine metabolites and myelosuppression risk.
monitoring: Blood count monitoring as described in the guideline.
limitations: Indication-specific (malignant vs non-malignant) advice is in the guideline; no dose is calculated here.

alternatives.text: No specific alternative is encoded; see the cited guideline.

rules.headline: TPMT intermediate metabolizer: reduced starting dose
rules.rationale: CPIC advises a reduced starting dose with titration for TPMT intermediate metabolizers.
rules.mechanism: Reduced TPMT activity increases active thiopurine metabolite exposure.
monitoring: Blood count monitoring as described in the guideline.
limitations: No dose is calculated here.

rules.headline: Avoid fluorouracil in DPYD poor metabolizers
rules.rationale: Guidance summarised from CPIC advises avoiding fluoropyrimidines in patients with very low or absent DPD activity because of the risk of severe, potentially fatal toxicity.
rules.mechanism: Reduced DPD activity impairs fluoropyrimidine breakdown, causing toxic accumulation.
limitations: Evidence is a secondary summary of CPIC; the primary guideline and any newer update must be checked.
Activity-score-specific advice is not encoded.

alternatives.text: No specific alternative is encoded; see the cited guideline.

rules.headline: SLCO1B1 decreased function: alternative statin or limited simvastatin dose
rules.rationale: CPIC 2022 advises an alternative statin; if simvastatin is warranted the dose should be limited per the guideline.
rules.mechanism: SLCO1B1 transports statins into the liver; reduced function raises systemic simvastatin acid exposure and myopathy risk.
limitations: Dose limits and alternative-statin choice are in the guideline; none is calculated here.

alternatives.text: No specific alternative is encoded; see the cited guideline.

rules.headline: SLCO1B1 poor function: choose an alternative statin
rules.rationale: CPIC 2022 advises prescribing an alternative statin in SLCO1B1 poor-function patients (substantially increased myopathy risk).
rules.mechanism: Markedly reduced hepatic uptake raises simvastatin acid exposure.
limitations: Choice of alternative depends on desired intensity; see guideline.

alternatives.text: No specific alternative is encoded; see the cited guideline.

rules.headline: SLCO1B1 decreased function: limit atorvastatin starting dose
rules.rationale: The ClinPGx annotation of CPIC 2022 states a starting dose of 40 mg or less for decreased/possibly decreased function.
rules.mechanism: Reduced hepatic uptake raises statin exposure.
monitoring: Be aware of increased myopathy risk, especially at higher doses.
limitations: Adult dosing only; secondary annotation.

alternatives.text: No specific alternative is encoded; see the cited guideline.

rules.headline: SLCO1B1 poor function: limit atorvastatin starting dose
rules.rationale: The ClinPGx annotation of CPIC 2022 states a starting dose of 20 mg or less for poor function.
rules.mechanism: Markedly reduced hepatic uptake raises statin exposure.
monitoring: Be aware of increased myopathy risk.
limitations: Adult dosing only; secondary annotation.
